Your role in our mission

Prosper is seeking an analytically-driven, values-led VP of Marketing to accelerate our mission of advancing financial well-being. As a key member of the executive leadership team, you will oversee the end-to-end marketing ecosystem - from performance-based acquisition to the launch of new borrowing and investing products. We need a leader who can mentor a talented team of 20+ while maintaining a sharp focus on ROI and market-leading brand positioning. Whether you work from our San Francisco headquarters or remotely in the US, you will be the lead storyteller and strategist connecting our products to the millions who need them.

How you’ll make an impact

- Drive scalable growth: You will own top-of-funnel metrics and multi-year marketing plans for our retail investor, personal loan, and credit card portfolios. You’ll determine requirements, assess support needs, build internal alignment, and deliver results that hit our aggressive volume targets. You will accelerate the development of enhanced machine learning targeting models and aggressive customer research.
- Define the competitive edge: You will lead us to beat the competition at our game - not theirs. This means overseeing deep market research and competitor analysis to drive recommendations that lean into Prosper’s unique marketplace advantages. You will lead a proactive PR strategy to ensure our strengths are clearly communicated and widely recognized by the market, media, and our customers.
- Influence the product roadmap: You will act as a key partner on new product design, bringing deep market intelligence and customer insights to the table to ensure our future offerings are positioned to win from day one.
- Level-up the team: You’ll mentor and empower our 20+-person team to be a data-first execution engine that thrives on mission-driven, high-performance culture.

Who you’ll build with

- Reporting to the CEO, you will work in close alignment with the President & CFO, CTO, and General Counsel to position marketing as a primary driver of Prosper’s financial and technical roadmap.
- You will collaborate daily with the Heads of Product, Credit, and Operations to deliver a seamless borrower and investor experience.
- You will lead the entire marketing organization, providing strategic oversight to your direct reports: the Sr. Director of Performance Marketing & Analytics, the Director of Web & Conversion, and the Sr. Partnerships Manager.

Skills that will help you thrive

- Fintech Leadership: 15+ years of marketing experience with a deep mastery of the personal loan and financial services landscape, including content, digital and product marketing.
- The ROI mindset: A proven track record of driving ROI-positive acquisition across multiple channels, including digital, direct mail, and lead aggregators.
- Data as a second language: Strong analytical rigor with the ability to use performance data to pivot strategies and uncover untapped market segments.
- Executive presence: High-level communication skills with a history of presenting performance and vision to employees and the Board of Directors.
- Regulatory fluency: A firm grasp of compliance and regulatory standards for advertising and acquisition in financial markets.
- Academic foundation: A degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.

Resources to help you prosper

- A connected experience: We prioritize high-touch collaboration and flexibility. Whether you are working from our San Francisco or Phoenix offices or joining us as a fully remote team member, we provide the digital-first tools and intentional culture to keep you synced and supported.
- Invested in your future: A competitive salary and a 401(k) with a 5% company match to help you build long-term financial security.
- Holistic well-being: We provide the resources you need to thrive, from flexible time off and paid parental leave to an annual wellness allowance and comprehensive health coverage.
- Professional & personal growth: Take advantage of a suite of premium perks, including Udemy access, childcare assistance, pet insurance, and a bevy of additional savings through Beneplace.

Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list.

Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

We need a Digital Advertising Strategist to help transform our digital advertising team into a data-driven performance machine. We want our team members to be proactive and persistent until they are able to turn data into profitable insights for our customers and partners alike.  We are looking for someone with extremely high standards who is efficient and not afraid to roll up their sleeves and do what it takes to help our partners be successful. If you are intelligent, organized, and a high-energy builder, we encourage you to apply. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule (three days in office, two days remote per week) based in Lehi, Utah.

What is a day in the life of a Digital Advertising Strategist?

- Manage and delegate the creation of PPC and display campaigns across Amazon, Walmart, Google, Facebook, etc.
- Perform market research to build tailored and relevant full-funnel strategies for clients
- Nurture partner relationships by meeting regularly to review performance, negotiate advertising budgets, and discuss strategy ideas
- Research and test effective keywords, bidding strategies, and ad copy to catalyze traffic and sales velocity
- Collaborate with the brand management team to align advertising goals with the internal ambitions set by our partners

What will I need to thrive in this role?

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related program
- 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in paid search and display advertising (Google Ads, Facebook, etc.)
- Demonstrable Excel knowledge, data analysis, and problem solving skills
- Prior experience in managing client relationships and communicating with key internal & external partners
- Demonstrable quickness in learning new things and an ambitious attitude

Preferred Qualifications:

- Working history with the Amazon advertising platform and third party tools like Helium 10, Pacvue, Viral Launch, etc.
- Knowledge of advanced auto-bid tools, such as Marin or DS3
- Skills in web analytics and relevant attribution models
- Experience in retail revenue strategy

What does high performance look like?

- You are agile and experimental, bringing new ideas and moving fast to achieve goals
- You are self-driven, organized, and proactive mindset with high ethical standards
- You love web analytics, attribution models, and are up to speed on all the latest trends
- You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner
- You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given
- You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion

What is my potential for career growth?

- You will learn valuable skills in Amazon Ads, leadership, and marketplace strategy as well as build relationships with department leaders at Pattern and brand executives. These skills and relationships can lead to career advancement within the company. We are passionate about developing our amazing talent and providing excellent opportunities for career growth within Pattern.

What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days?

- 30 Days - you have your team schedule and structure established with regular 1:1s, you build strong relationships with team members, brand managers, and brand partners
- 60 Days - you hold regular strategy sessions to share valuable suggestions with brand partners
- 90 Days - you build and execute successful ad strategies and understand the nuances of your brands’ advertising needs

What is the team like?

- You will work with the other Associate Directors and Ad Strategists and be supervised by the Director of Digital Advertising. You will also be mentored by the VP of Advertising and meet with them on a regular basis to discuss your performance. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.

We want individuals who are:

- Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
- Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
- Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
- Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

- Initial phone interview with Pattern’s talent acquisition team
- Video interview with a hiring manager
- Onsite interview with a panel of department leaders
- Professional reference checks
- Executive review
- Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

- Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples
- Be ready to talk about how you can add value and be the best addition to the team
- Focus on mentioning how you would make a difference at Pattern
- Be prepared to talk about any side projects related to data and analytics

Why should I work at Pattern?

Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:

- Unlimited PTO

- Paid Holidays

- Onsite Fitness Center

- Company Paid Life Insurance

- Casual Dress Code

- Competitive Pay

- Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

- 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred.

About Healthcare.com

Healthcare.com is a healthcare technology company building smarter ways to connect people and partners with the coverage, care, and solutions they need.

We’re three businesses, one company. Through Marketplace, Pivot Health, and TrustRx, our work spans health insurance marketplaces, flexible health coverage, and pharmacy, giving us more ways to solve meaningful problems across the healthcare ecosystem.

Healthcare doesn’t stand still, and neither do we. We’re curious, collaborative, and always looking for better ways to solve problems, use technology, and make an impact.

About The Role

The Growth Marketing Manager is a newly created role responsible for growing Pivot Health’s direct-to-consumer business across every channel that can produce profitable enrollments while assisting with B2B growth. Reporting to the Director of Insurance Marketing, this person owns the growth agenda for the channel: finding where traction exists, proving where it might, and scaling what works.

Day-to-day management of paid search sits with an established agency partner. This role sets the direction that partner works against, and spends the balance of its time making sure our conversion and attribution signal is accurate across paid, organic, email, and phone; testing new channels against a defined bar; and building the partner relationships that open new sources of volume.

This is a role for a growth marketer rather than a channel specialist. You will be measured on enrollments and contribution margin, not on activity, and you will have real latitude to decide where the next dollar and the next experiment go.

What You'll Do

Channel Growth & Scaling

- Own the performance of paid search and paid social as channels — setting targets, allocating budget, and holding the agency partner accountable for volume, cost-per-acquisition, and return on ad spend

- Manage acquisition budgets across channels, continuously reallocating spend toward the highest-performing sources

- Direct campaign, keyword, audience, creative, and landing page strategy with the agency partner, and own the decisions that follow from what the tests show

- Partner with Finance and Analytics to forecast spend, model unit economics, and hit blended CAC targets

Measurement & Attribution

- Own the accuracy of the conversion and revenue signal returned to advertising platforms across paid, organic, email, and phone

- Coordinate with Data and Engineering to specify, prioritize, and validate tracking work — including offline conversion uploads, click-ID capture, and how conversion value is defined

- Own call attribution through Invoca end to end, connecting calls to dispositions, enrollments, and economic outcomes, and returning those events to the originating platform

- Reconcile platform-reported performance against the internal source of record, and resolve the differences rather than reporting around them

- Translate marketing requirements into scoped engineering tickets and carry them through to verified delivery

Organic & Partner Growth

- Develop and execute the SEO strategy to grow organic traffic and reduce dependence on paid channels

- Source, negotiate, and manage affiliate, referral, and content partnerships — owning them from first conversation through to profitable volume

- Evaluate and onboard new acquisition partners, lead aggregators, and eCommerce sources

- Develop organic social and content-led channels as potential growth surfaces, working with the Content Marketing Manager on execution

Testing & New Channel Development

- Run a structured program of channel tests, defining the traction threshold and the measurement approach for each one before it launches

- Make a clear scale, iterate, or stop recommendation on every test, and document what was learned either way

- Define acquisition KPIs and build reporting that ties channel spend to enrolled members and lifetime value

- Set the strategic direction for conversion rate optimization in partnership with the Director of Insurance Marketing, and work with the Content Marketing Manager to ensure a seamless hand-off from traffic to conversion

- Identify and act on new channel opportunities to diversify and de-risk the acquisition mix

Collaboration

- Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to align acquisition targeting with retention and lifetime-value goals

- Work cross-functionally with Product, Operations, and Analytics to align acquisition strategy with company priorities

- Contribute the consumer perspective to Pivot Health’s positioning, messaging, and brand direction

- Contribute to the Growth & Marketing roadmap and quarterly operating plan

Who You Are

- 5+ years of growth marketing experience spanning multiple acquisition channels, with genuine depth in at least two of them

- A track record of taking a channel from unproven to producing — you have found traction somewhere that did not have it before, and can explain how you knew it was real

- Demonstrated success owning acquisition budgets and hitting CPA, ROAS, or CAC targets in a high-volume, direct-to-consumer environment

- Deeply analytical — comfortable with data, attribution, funnel metrics, and building the business case for spend

- Comfortable directing agencies and contractors — you have held an outside partner to a number and know the difference between activity and results

- Experience building partnerships or affiliate relationships, including sourcing and negotiating them, not only managing them once signed

- Working fluency with Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and web analytics tools (e.g., GA4) — enough to set strategy and interrogate results, without needing to be the person in the account every day

- Able to work directly with data and engineering teams on measurement problems — scoping requirements, prioritizing them, and validating that what shipped actually works

- Self-starter comfortable operating without a fully built infrastructure and building programs from the ground up

- Excellent communicator and collaborator across internal and external stakeholders

Preferred / Strong Plus

- Experience marketing insurance, financial services, or other regulated/consideration-driven products

- Familiarity with lead generation, lead aggregators, and eCommerce/DTC acquisition models

- Experience with affiliate, partnership, or business development motions in a consumer business

- Hands-on exposure to conversion tracking, offline conversion imports, or call tracking platforms such as Invoca

- Experience with the U65 / non-ACA insurance market

- Prior work in a start-up, scale-up, or private equity-backed business

Why Healthcare.com

We’re building a company for people who want to be part of what’s changing, not watching it happen. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take on meaningful challenges, share new ideas, and make an impact you can see.

- Company funded HSA contributions from $2,000 to $4,000 annually
